name: Split Face Trend: Half Your Face, Half Your Parent's
blurb: The split face trend is the TikTok and Instagram trend where one black-and-white portrait joins the left half of your face to the right half of your mom's or dad's, straight down the middle.

prompts.text: Create a photorealistic black and white portrait collage of the two uploaded images. Connect the faces of the person in the first image and the person in the second image strictly vertically in the center: the left half of the final face is half of the face of the person in the first image, the right half is half of the face of the person in the second image. It is very important to maintain as much as possible the real characteristics of both people in the original photos, not to change their appearance and not to make an average face. The faces should be perfectly aligned in the middle. The connecting line should run exactly through the middle of the forehead, nose, lips and chin. Special attention should be paid: both eyes were completely visible and each eye retained the shape, cut and characteristics of its person; the cut of the eyes and eyebrows corresponded as much as possible to the original photos; the nose was connected exactly in the middle, so that the shape of the nose, the bridge of the nose and both nostrils were clearly visible; the lips were very clear and distinct, while the left half of the lips corresponded to the person in the first image and the right belonged to the person in the second image; the shape of each person's upper and lower lips was preserved; the position of the eyes matched, nose, lips and chin to make the face look natural and symmetrical; do not mix features between halves and do not change the shape of the face. Take a large full-face portrait, one person looks directly into the camera, neutral expression. Black and white photo with high details of skin, eyes, eyelashes, eyebrows, lips and hair. Soft even studio lighting, light neutral background, high sharpness, realistic photographic texture, no filter and strong retouching. The result should look like a real professional photo, exactly divided into two halves between two people. Vertical 9:16, framed like a passport photo from the top of the head to the upper chest, the face large in the middle. Each half keeps its own person's hair, ear, neck and clothes on its side, at the same head size and eye level, each at the age in their own photo. If a photo is in color, old or turned to the side, show that person facing the camera in black and white with the same face. A clean, straight seam: no gap, no blur, no drawn line. Exactly one split face, nobody else. No text, no logos, no watermark, no border. The identity rules below apply to each half: the left half is the exact person from the first image, the right half the exact person from the second image, never a blend of the two.
